_about: Hand-labelled final verdict class of the 19 corpus reviews whose class changes between 'first verdict in the last Pass section / whole file' and 'last statement in document order'. Each label was read from the file itself (the document's last real verdict statement, not a quote of another document and not prose). Frozen 2026-11-20; the files are archived or settled, so the expected values do not move with the parser.
